title: NRF Survey: 142 Million Shoppers Expected for Super Saturday

facts.fact: According to the NRF and Prosper Insights & Analytics survey, nearly 142 million consumers planned to shop on the last Saturday before Christmas.
facts.quote: Nearly 142 million consumers plan to shop on the last Saturday before Christmas, according to the latest survey from the National Retail Federation and Prosper Insights & Analytics.

facts.fact: The NRF release says 126 million consumers were expected to shop on Super Saturday in 2017, when it last fell on Dec. 23.
facts.quote: when 126 million consumers were expected to shop on that day in 2017.

facts.fact: In the NRF and Prosper survey, approximately 53 million (37%) Super Saturday shoppers expected to shop exclusively in stores in 2023, up from about 44 million (28%) the prior year.
facts.quote: Approximately 53 million (37%) Super Saturday shoppers expect they will shop exclusively in stores this year, up from about 44 million (28%) last year

facts.fact: In the NRF and Prosper survey, 58 million (41%) Super Saturday shoppers planned to shop both online and in stores.
facts.quote: 58 million (41%) plan to shop both online and in stores.

facts.fact: In the NRF and Prosper survey, around 31 million (22%) Super Saturday shoppers planned to shop exclusively online.
facts.quote: Around 31 million (22%) plan to shop exclusively online.

facts.fact: As of early December, holiday shoppers had picked up about half (49%) of the items on their lists, per the survey.
facts.quote: As of early December, holiday shoppers have picked up about half (49%) of the items on their lists.

facts.fact: Among shoppers with more than half their shopping remaining, over one-third (36%) said they were still figuring out what to buy.
facts.quote: For those who still have more than half of their shopping remaining, over one-third (36%) say they are still figuring out what to buy.

facts.fact: In November, 85% of Thanksgiving weekend shoppers expected deals during the rest of the holiday season to be the same or better than Thanksgiving weekend.
facts.quote: In November, 85% of Thanksgiving weekend shoppers said they expected the deals during the rest of the holiday season to be the same or better than Thanksgiving weekend.

facts.fact: Online was cited by 49% of consumers as a destination where they would finish their holiday shopping.
facts.quote: Popular destinations where consumers will finish their shopping include online (49%)

facts.fact: Department stores were cited by 38% of consumers as a destination where they would finish their holiday shopping.
Discount stores were cited by 28% of consumers as a destination where they would finish their holiday shopping.
Clothing and accessories stores were cited by 26% of consumers as a destination where they would finish their holiday shopping.
